title: MacNeal–Harder twisted beam
source: MacNeal and Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3–20, Fig. 6 (p. 8), Table 3 (p. 10)
requires: a helical shell mesh: mesh.block's 2D form is planar and takes z = 0, so the twisted strip must be written node by node (as scordelis-lo-roof-shell and pinched-cylinder are), or mapped blocks must gain helical edges

quantities.quantity: tip displacement along the in-plane load
tip displacement along the out-of-plane load
